text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-a-at this rate, Opera O is going to—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I just performed a divination predicting
that a
catastrophic disaster, too terrible
for words to
describe, will befall Opera
O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-we have to find her right now and get
her to
safety! We can't waste any time!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you two! Your timing couldn't
have been
any better! Why, I was just
about to start
rehearsing an all-new
opera!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-please, you have to listen! Disaster will
soon
strike! You have to get to
somewhere safe!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Disaster? Ha ha ha! Pray tell—what
exactly is this
impending disaster you
speak of?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-it's um... one that goes wham and swoosh, like crash, and uh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A horrendous fortune poised to wreak

cataclysmic levels of havoc is upon you!
With a
bonus of blizzards, lightning,
volcanic eruptions,
even...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Fear not! Such measly threats
will only
serve to enhance my
performance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let those grim thoughts burden
you no
further. Join me on stage, and
allow me to win
back your lovely smiles
with my brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-okay... Oh, what's this... wonderful
feeling?
This ray of light I feel in my
chest, driving away
my fears.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! Th-th-th-that's not right! Ohhh...
How are
we supposed to save Opera O
now?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I just performed another
divination
and have now discovered a
way to save her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To cut to the chase—we must fight evil
with evil...
Doto, you must become a
demon!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A d-demon?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You must become a demon far more

terrifying than any catastrophe, and then
frighten
Opera O into hiding! Can you
do this?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I can! If it means Opera O will be
saved, I'll do
anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then, I shall call upon a
demon to
possess your body! Hold these
incense sticks with
both hands and keep
this slab of butter plus this
rice cracker
in your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hummm... Dracula caterpillar specter...
Crying
carrot, flappy fried rice!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Doot! ...Installing—Demon.exe!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, what is the matter? Don't be shy,
come
here and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I, I am no Doto! Da-dum! I am a
yokai—wait no,
an evil tanuki possessing
this girl's body! Da-dum!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Another adorable little tanuki
wants to
make friends!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll put a curse on you if you don't
leave right
now! I'll give you a tanuki's
tail, or... I'll turn you
into a tea kettle!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a tale of shapeshifting, I see! Ha ha
ha! You
have my attention!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-no... Y-you should fear me! I have
even more
terrible curses up my sleeve, I
swear!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-this girl here, she might never be
able to see
your beautiful face anymore,
you know?! I-if that
happens... she's
gonna be very sad!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Dear Tanuki, do you mean that
you can
sense Doto's trepidation?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-of course! She's so worried! If you don't run away soon, her heart's gonna... sniffle... burst!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Duly noted! After all, it is true
that a
curtain of darkness would fall
upon this world if
anything were to
happen to me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Y-you're going to go?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I shall heed your warning and take
my leave.
Adieu!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-thank goodness! Opera O is saved!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-thank goodness! Opera O is saved!

I wonder what would have happened if we'd just left it alone...
I wonder what would have happened if we'd just left it alone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh? Are you saying... the demon
had no
effect on Opera O's
decision-making?
choice_data_list: Your sincerity must have reached them.
I wonder what would have happened if we'd just left it alone...
I wonder what would have happened if we'd just left it alone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I-in any case, I'm glad she's fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Speaking of which, Trainer... Aren't
you
standing right where Opera O was a
moment ago?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when a bicycle furiously speeds
by me,
going right over the puddle of
water next to
where I'm standing.

text_block_list.name: Doto and Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showered in muddy water and stares of
pity, I
come to terms with my misfortune.
